items.prompt: Create a new wide 16:9 background illustration for the Chinese visual novel 雨停之前. Use the attached bookshop image only as a reference for its soft detailed anime painterly art style, warm realistic architecture and muted green/ochre palette; create a completely different scene. Scene: an old university neighborhood rooftop terrace at 4pm in June after rain has cleared. Safe high solid parapet, two folding chairs angled toward each other, a small table with two paper cups, a few pots of leafy plants, a closed acoustic guitar case leaning safely beside a chair. Distant red-brick campus buildings, trees and a quiet summer sky. Golden afternoon light, clean dry terrace, intimate calm atmosphere suitable for a conversation. Eye-level wide composition, leave central foreground spacious for character sprites and lower quarter unobtrusive for dialogue overlay. No people, no readable text, no logos or watermarks. Match the polished hand-painted visual novel background style, not a photo.
